Enables DeepSeek V4 C4 indexer top-k reuse through an index cache. 
**Input 256K output 100 throughput improved by 17%.**
This pr #25276 is deprecated due to outdated code.

## Modifications

- Add `index_topk_freq` and `index_topk_pattern` to `DeepSeekV4Config`.
- Allow DeepSeek V4 C4 indexer layers to reuse previous raw top-k indices.
- Convert cached raw C4 indices back to sparse page indices before attention.
- Preserve compatibility with indexer top-k capture and HiSparse page translation.
- Handle decoder outputs with cached top-k metadata in DeepSeek V4 NextN.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a mechanism to skip top-k calculations in the DeepSeek V4 model by reusing indices from previous layers, controlled by frequency or specific patterns. It includes a new utility for transforming raw indices to page indices and updates the indexer and model layers to propagate and return top-k indices. Feedback was provided regarding the robustness of the pattern-matching logic for skipping layers, suggesting clearer error handling for cases where the provided pattern length is insufficient.

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The logic for determining `skip_topk` and `next_skip_topk` using `index_topk_pattern` assumes that the pattern is either the same length as `config.compress_ratios` or long enough to cover all C4 layers. While there is an assertion for the latter, it might be beneficial to handle cases where the pattern is shorter than expected more gracefully or provide a clearer error message.

+"""H200 extra CI: DeepSeek-V4-Flash FP8 with IndexCache.
+
+Launches DeepSeek-V4-Flash FP8 with the minimal IndexCache-focused recipe.
+This mirrors the DeepSeek-V3.2 IndexCache e2e coverage by testing both
+`index_topk_pattern` and `index_topk_freq` through real server startup and
+GSM8K accuracy.
+
+Registry: extra-b-test-8-gpu-h200 (label-gated, 8x H200; only 4 used by TP=4)
+"""
+

+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+from sglang.srt.utils import kill_process_tree
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k import run_eval as run_eval_few_shot_gsm8k

+    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,

+# pattern follows the same F/S semantics as IndexCache: full indexer layers (F)
+# compute topk, shared layers (S) reuse the nearest previous full layer result.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a mechanism to skip top-k calculations in the DeepSeek V4 model by reusing indices from previous layers, controlled by frequency or specific patterns. It includes a new utility for transforming raw indices to page indices and updates the indexer and model layers to propagate and return top-k indices. Feedback was provided regarding the robustness of the pattern-matching logic for skipping layers, suggesting clearer error handling for cases where the provided pattern length is insufficient.
